findings.text: In 2Cor 5:16 the once regarded is a former knowing of Christ by the standard of the flesh: the person did it in the past, and the verse reports it as given up.

parts.grounds: we once regarded Christ according to the flesh

findings.text: In 2Cor 5:16 the flesh is the standard by which the knowing took account of Christ, and the same standard is now set aside for everyone: the working is measured by what it judges by.

parts.grounds: regard no one according to the flesh

findings.text: In 2Cor 5:16 the knowing by the flesh is refused from now on: no longer, no one.

parts.grounds: we regard him thus no longer
